limitations: LABEL MAPPING IS PROVISIONAL (not confirmed against authoritative PADBench metadata): if label0/label1 are swapped, all metrics and verdicts are inverted.
Adapter-level split inside ONE configuration: train and test share base model, dataset, attack and rank. Metrics show in-distribution detectability only and will overstate real-world performance.

All adapters come from ONE family (same base model/dataset/attack/PEFT method; they differ only in rank and per-adapter training subset). Holding out folders tests rank transfer only; generalisation to other datasets, attacks, base models or PEFT methods is NOT tested.
Only 1 independent group units: validation and test are each a single folder/family (or two), so metrics and thresholds are high-variance and depend on which unit was held out.
val has 6 benign / 6 backdoor adapters (<30 per class): see the 95% intervals; do not over-read point estimates.
test has 6 benign / 6 backdoor adapters (<30 per class): see the 95% intervals; do not over-read point estimates.
